label: v0 eb936d4 baseline
note: HEAD before loop; flexalign-shaped harness added

label: v1 wfadaptive: no distance buffer
note: WF-adaptive cutoff: single vectorisable min pass, distances recomputed at the ends instead of stored

label: v2 null-fill at alloc, no init_ends
note: Wavefront::init NULL-fills the requested range once; trim_ends nulls trimmed diagonals; the 8 per-step init_ends fills are gone

label: v3 AVX2 null fill, pads only
note: fill_null with 256-bit stores; output wavefronts null only their pads (init_output); tried+dropped: AVX2 trim_ends (+8% slower, trims are 0-2 diagonals), in-place regrow of recycled wavefronts (+5% slower: dead arena space forced frequent clears)

label: v4 ends-free extend: one pass
note: extend_matches_packed_endsfree checks termination once per diagonal during the chunk pass (remembering the lowest <4-char terminating diagonal) instead of a second full pass; same winner as C's AVX2 order

label: v5 affine kernel: no scalar tail
note: AVX2 affine kernel computes the partial tail as an overlapping full block and narrow wavefronts with masked loads (+ pad reset); fill_null short-pad fast path; per-step and in-kernel prefetches removed (neutral). Dropped: scalar-first vector trim (+7% slower)

label: v6 32-byte extend, AVX2 min-distance
note: extend compares 32 characters per step (sequence buffers have 64 bytes of padding past the sentinels); WF-adaptive min-distance pass hand-vectorised with an overlapping last block (no scalar remainder)

label: v7 CIGAR wavefronts sized by need
note: Tight (CIGAR) slab allocates wavefronts at 1.5x the requested length rounded to 32 (min 64) instead of a fixed 1000 elements: peak heap 1.6 MB -> 92 KB (150bp), 11 MB -> 2.2 MB (1k). Dropped: gather-based AVX2 extend for small wavefronts (+20% slower on drop case)

label: v8 trim within input hull
note: affine outputs are trimmed only within the union of their inputs' initialised ranges (outside is null by invariant), skipping the long null runs of I1/D1. Dropped: running min-distance fused into extend (+7% drop, +14% dovetail: the vector pass is cheaper than a per-diagonal scalar min)

label: v9 affine kernel inlined
note: compute_affine_idm and its AVX2 body are inline(always) when AVX2 is a compile-time target feature (target-cpu=native), removing an 11-argument call per step

label: v10 AVX-512VL bounds check, 3-in-1 alloc
note: kernel bounds check uses unsigned compare-to-mask + mask blend when avx512vl is a compile-time feature (LLVM lowered the AVX2 blendv path into ~10 mask-conversion ops); the three affine outputs come from one slab call

label: v11 vector reduce scan (scalar-first)
note: WF-adaptive reduce: scalar check of the end diagonal, then 8-lane blocks with the alignment-diagonal limit folded into the lane mask; same lo/hi as the scalar loop. Pure vector version (no scalar-first) was +1-2% slower on short reads

label: v12 M hull from kernel masks (dropped)
note: kernel tracked M's in-bounds hull per block to skip M's trim scan: +6%/+4% slower on the drop case (branchy and branchless variants), +2-3% on 1k/dovetail, ~1% faster on narrow 150bp e2e. The kernel block is too hot for extra bookkeeping; M's trim is already short thanks to the hull bounds (v8).

label: v13 8-slot pads for I1/D1 (failed)
note: I1/D1 outputs nulled only 8 slots around [lo,hi]: harness detected non-deterministic output (dovetail, 1k). Older M inputs can be much wider than a heuristic-pruned I1/D1, so the kernel reads I1/D1 down to the historic minimum; pads must cover the whole allocation. Harness checksum now folds 8 bytes at a time (was ~7% of measured time on short reads); baseline rebuilt with it (checksums changed, code unchanged).

label: v14 64-char extend compare (dropped)
note: extend comparing 64 characters per step, as one 512-bit compare (+4.5% drop, +5.5% dovetail: 512-bit ops are double-pumped on this Zen 5) and as two 256-bit compares (+4% drop, +5% dovetail, -2% 150bp 2%). The hot 'all matched?' branch is load-throughput bound, not mispredict bound.

label: v15 begin-free init as fill + ramp
note: init_alignment writes the ends-free begin-free diagonals as a zero fill and an identity ramp over exclusive ranges (inclusive-range loops were 60% of init_alignment)

label: v16 lazy init_ends / inlined cutoff (dropped)
note: (a) inline(always) on apply_heuristic_cutoff: neutral to +1-3% slower. (b) C's lazy scheme on top of today's code (no pad fill at allocation, init_ends_lower/higher with the fast fill before the kernel): +15% 150bp, +19% drop, +10% dovetail, +25% 1k. Pad fill at allocation stays.

label: v17 one pad-fill dispatch for 3 outputs
note: allocate_output_ptrs sets the fields of the three outputs and nulls their pads with fill_null_n (one length dispatch per side for all three arrays); fill_null's dispatch was ~10% of the compute step's instructions

label: v18 compute step specialised on memory mode
note: compute_affine_step_impl::<const MODULAR: bool>: in CIGAR mode slot lookups are direct indices and the free-on-null-step branches vanish

label: v19 specialised gap-affine main loop
note: affine_packed_loop_impl::<MODULAR, HEURISTIC, ENDSFREE>: extend, termination, cutoff and compute step in one loop specialised at compile time (gap-affine + ASCII sequences); other metrics and lambda sequences keep the generic loop

label: v20 kernel/init branch trims
note: tail_room computed only for wavefronts narrower than 8; kernel's count<=0 guard removed (caller guarantees lo<=hi); bt_occupancy_max reset unconditionally. Also: tests/wfa_utest.sh (60 C-reference cases incl. BiWFA, full CIGAR identity) passes on v18.

label: v21 per-score arrays capped by max steps
note: WavefrontComponents::resize caps num_wavefronts at max_alignment_steps + 1 in CIGAR mode (flexalign always sets an ANI abort score): peak heap 150bp 93 KB -> 22 KB, 1k 0.5% 0.50 MB -> 55 KB, 1k 5% 2.2 -> 1.8 MB [taken for memory: speed neutral 0.999x]

label: v22 smaller initial arena + null wavefronts
note: slab arena first chunk 256 KB -> 64 KB, null/victim wavefronts +-1024 -> +-256: aligner base footprint 293 KB -> 90 KB. Growth during alignment is now visible as arena chunks (the old chunk hid it): 150bp total 315 -> 308 KB. Harness now reports aligner_heap; baseline rebuilt with it (code unchanged). [taken for memory: speed neutral 0.998x]

label: v23 wavefront size rounded to 16
note: Tight sizing 1.5x headroom rounded to 16 (was 32), min 48: 1k 5% growth 1.88 -> 1.81 MB, 150bp 2% one 64 KB chunk less. A 1.25x/16 variant saved 30% on short reads but cost +20% on 1k 5% (recycle misses -> dead arena space); not taken. [taken for memory: speed 0.996x]

label: v24 no compute at max steps; lazy cutoff buffer
note: the main loops check max_alignment_steps before computing the wavefront that would never be extended (identical result: MaxStepsReached has no output); apply_heuristic_cutoff prepares the victim scratch buffer only for X/Z-drop

label: final: v23 vs v0 (same harness)
note: Closing measurement of the loop: the final library (v23, commit 851f3fb) against the v0 library (eb936d4) built with the identical benchmark harness, same machine, same session.

label: v24a intermediate (superseded by v24)
note: Intermediate build of the fix with arena chunks doubling from the start (small-read heap growth 0.22 -> 0.43 MB by chunk quantisation); superseded by v24.

label: v24 null-range fix, exact large sizes, growing arena chunks
note: Correctness fix (taken regardless of speed): use-after-free read of the null wavefront when its range is recomputed 1 wide (same arithmetic in C; made reachable by v22's +-256 range). Also: Tight headroom only <=1024 elements; arena chunks 64 KB x4 then doubling to 1 MB. Peak RSS on utest CIGAR configs: affine2p ends-free 4.2 GB -> 2.27 GB (v0 2.45), affine 540 -> 279 MB (v0 293). Full 1710-config matrix vs C: failure set identical to v0 (1029 pass). [taken: correctness fix; speed 1.009x within noise]

label: v25 C-identity fixes (null steps, null inputs, ends-free match reward, SIMD-lane order, range union, BiWFA unreachable)
note: Bug-fix round: port of C's null-step accounting, null-input substitution, exact input-range union, match-reward ends-free diagonals, SIMD-lane-dependent ends-free termination order, BiWFA base unreachable check. [taken: correctness fix; dovetail checksum changes by design (ends-free termination order now matches C for the build SIMD width); scores unchanged]. Matrix vs C: 1452 pass / 226 fail / 4 crashes, 0 regressions vs v0 (423 fixed). 213+19 cargo tests, 60/60 C-reference.

label: v26 bug fixes (Z-drop end, affine2p band overflow, edit band leak, unreachable guard, X-drop backtrace)
note: Bug-fix round 2: Z-drop scored/backtraced at the drop position; per-score arrays grow instead of overflowing; edit/indel null cells around previous wavefront (C); stop at max path score when a heuristic makes the end unreachable; backtrace skips null-flagged earlier-score sources; dropped BiWFA bases traced from M. [superseded by v26b: sharing compute_step with the ends-free loop changed inlining of the end-to-end loop, +5%]

label: v26 bug fixes (re-run on quiet machine)
note: Same build as iteration 30; first run overlapped the tail of the C-matrix runs. [superseded by v26b: sharing compute_step with the ends-free loop changed inlining of the end-to-end loop, +5%]

label: v26b bug fixes, hot path restored
note: v26 with the ends-free loop's direct compute dispatch restored (sharing compute_step changed inlining of the end-to-end loop) and the score-only terminate bookkeeping out of line. [taken: correctness fixes, speed neutral (1.007x, within noise); outputs identical to v25 on all flexalign workloads].
